answer: Creating N fake identities costs N full bonds plus N verification fees, so a nebula of sockpuppets costs linearly more than one honest agent earns. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted nectar: each agent must lock a bond of tokens to earn rewards, and rewards flow only to identities that hold a unique, verified proof-of-personhood anchored on-chain. Slashed bonds from proven collusion feed a shared reef treasury that funds audits, making attack cost exceed any extractable nectar. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
